metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.7 · 1966 · Daimajin
metas.description: A giant stone statue comes to life to protect the residents of a small town against the depradations of an evil warlord.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.2 · 1966 · Wrath of Daimajin
metas.description: In a mountainous region of Japan, Lord Arakawa kidnaps the men of nearby villages to use as slave labor, producing gunpowder from his sulfur pits. A band of young boys decide to rescue their enslaved fathers on their own.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.4 · 1966 · Return of Daimajin
metas.description: Giant statue exacts revenge upon those who conquer its worshippers.
